o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آسمان (āsmān), borrowed from Classical Persian آسْمَان (āsmān), from Old Persian 𐎠𐎿𐎶𐎴 (a-s-m-n /⁠asman⁠/), borrowed from Old Median *asmā, from Proto-Iranian *Hácmā, from Proto-Indo-Iranian *Háćmā, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂éḱmō, from *h₂eḱ- + *-mō..

From Arabic اِخْتِصَاص (iḵtiṣāṣ), verbal noun of اِخْتَصَّ (iḵtaṣṣa).
Compare Turkish ihtisas.
From sür- + -ək. The temporal sense is from the senses 'to last, to go on', whereas the animal-related senses are from the sense 'to drive (of animals)'.
